thread:
zara: heads-up — planning a short quiet-window v2 push tomorrow 02:00 UTC. small blast radius, want header-negotiation + streaming sanity checks only.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout id=rb-2026-05-10-01, initial canary=5%, window=02:00-02:45 UTC. posting snapshots to console.

li: quick ask — docs blurb needs to mention that `x-redwood-version` is optional and that older SDKs will stay on v1 unless explicit. i'll add the snippet.

sam: rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >= 0.8% for 4m OR 95p latency > 700ms for 5m -> auto-pin. add streaming-frame-drop >0.3% over 5m -> ops-eyes.

alex: probe plan: `v2-negotiation-probe` (http+stream) interval=30s, fail_threshold=3, auth_grace=90s. 4 consecutive probe fails -> auto-pin.

zara: pinlist for this run: internal tenants only — ["int-sanity","perf-check"]. external customers excluded.

zara: deploy command (ops-approved):
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-05-10-01 \
  --route /api/v2 \
  --canary 5 \
  --probe v2-negotiation-probe \
  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: canary started. diverting 5% of eligible traffic to v2. snapshots every 2m.

li: added release-note blurb + migration FAQ (how to opt-in and how to pin back). linking PR once merged.

sam: 20m check: 95p latency 430ms, error_rate 0.09%, token_cost_delta +3%. no auto-pins.

alex: 1h mark: metrics stable. recommending expand to 20% internal in next quiet window if still green.

zara: thanks — will schedule the broader ramp and prep comms. keeping this thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
